WITH pair_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    trd.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as pair_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader trd ON tr.trdref = trd.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, trd.tradekind
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(pair_count) as total_count FROM pair_counts
),
pair_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.tradekind,
    pc.pair_count,
    CAST(pc.pair_count AS NUMERIC) / ts.total_count as pair_share
  FROM pair_counts pc
  CROSS JOIN total_sum ts
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(pair_count) as avg_count_per_pair,
  AVG(pair_share) as avg_share_per_pair
FROM pair_shares
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind
